scope: 300 imported trajectories; programs proposed from completed prior tool output; next actions used as labels only

limitations: SWE-agent custom commands are not bash; no recorded action executed.
Unique navigation proposals use only prior result and current harness state; next action is an offline label.
Navigation changes open-file state; deployment must use a harness adapter and preserve state/observations.
Exact next action matches are opportunities, not avoided calls or proven task outcomes.
Repeated failed actions may warrant cycle detection but returning the same error alone cannot repair model reasoning or save the generation already made.
Scroll continuation does not reveal a safe stop condition in prior information.
Sample is discovery-only:92 records use swe-agent-llama-70b,7 llama-8b,1 llama-405b; no token/timing usage. Failure loops are not evidence of modern model generality.
Discovery observations only; no frozen heldout evaluation or causal savings.
Proposal inputs precede target actions; next-action comparisons label potential only.
Native structured edits already exist: another exact-replacement API is not a new optimization here.
Output expansion adds context; historical file content beyond displayed ranges is unavailable.
Exact tool-action reproduction does not establish preservation of assistant reasoning or task success.
Read repair prototype emits bounded arguments only; no source files, imports or recorded commands executed.
Repair assumes unchanged file version and immediate serialized retry; any repeated error falls back.
Pytest loop is a compatibility label, not authorization to run tests after every edit.
All missing non-finish tool-result targets excluded; finish calls normally have no tool result.
Synthetic issue variants share repository/base groups; counts are not independent trials.
Reported outcomes, model identities, token usage, latency and costs are absent.
Assistant turns are not measured API query counts.
Source observations are inert evidence; no imported commands executed and no bug success independently verified.
Write-run policy fixes registered interpreter python before labels; runtime must register actual environment and require explicit opt-in.
A file write is not authorization to execute arbitrary code; planner stays inactive without explicit run-after-write policy.
Whole-next-command matches are observational opportunities, not causally proven calls saved.
Script hash must be checked before execution and may be stale; script contents are not statically proven safe.
Terminal handoff needs explicit completion intent; cannot infer completion from previous test success.
Compact edit utility already exists; replacing its shell wrapper may reduce generated bytes, not a whole turn.
Byte comparisons include argument JSON, exclude tool names/schema, and do not establish token savings.

nextStep: Freeze policies, evaluate separate issue/base groups, then compare full live tasks including routing/fallback costs.
